surfaces.name: root
surfaces.workspace_semantics: --workspace is a base directory; the selected team name is appended
surfaces.output_contract: --output=json emits one jsonRunOutput document on stdout
surfaces.exit_contract: canonical RunResult exit code; success 0, general failure 1, acceptance failure 7, cancellation 130

surfaces.name: chat
surfaces.workspace_semantics: uses the root legacy base workspace and retains one loaded team across turns
surfaces.output_contract: interactive text stream; help is side-effect free
surfaces.exit_contract: command/setup errors are non-zero; per-turn cancellation stays inside the REPL

surfaces.name: resume
surfaces.workspace_semantics: explicit --workspace is exact; otherwise --agent-team is appended to the default root
surfaces.exit_contract: missing or ambiguous session is non-zero before execution

surfaces.name: retry
surfaces.workspace_semantics: uses the same exact-or-inferred resolver as resume
surfaces.output_contract: text TargetedRecoveryReport or one JSON report

surfaces.name: reconcile
surfaces.workspace_semantics: uses the same exact-or-inferred resolver as resume
surfaces.output_contract: text TargetedRecoveryReport or one JSON report

surfaces.name: context
surfaces.workspace_semantics: --workspace is exact for context maintenance commands
surfaces.output_contract: command-specific text or JSON; private content requires explicit selectors
surfaces.exit_contract: validation and repository errors are non-zero

surfaces.name: promotion
surfaces.workspace_semantics: --workspace is exact and project/team are explicit
surfaces.output_contract: list defaults to content-free output; approve and apply remain separate
surfaces.exit_contract: invalid lifecycle transitions and stale proposals are non-zero

surfaces.name: inspect
surfaces.workspace_semantics: --workspace is exact and never created by inspection
surfaces.output_contract: schema_version=1 envelope; JSON is one document
surfaces.exit_contract: 0 query success, 1 integrity failure, 2 usage or selection failure

surfaces.name: skill
surfaces.workspace_semantics: named-team lifecycle resolves the team definition separately from its usage workspace
surfaces.exit_contract: invalid team, draft, or lifecycle operation is non-zero

surfaces.name: team
surfaces.workspace_semantics: authoring targets team definitions; lint/show do not create a runtime workspace
surfaces.output_contract: team lint JSON v1 is a single stable document
